## Nextpower Hosts Capital Markets Day


November 17, 2026


*Company announced updated 2030 financial targets of revenue of more than $7.5 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $1.6 billion, reflecting accelerated growth across its expanded platform*


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power generation and energy storage solutions, today updated its 2030 financial outlook at its Capital Markets Day, reflecting the expansion of its product portfolio and accelerated execution of its strategy.


Nextpower is now targeting more than $7.5 billion in revenue, more than $1.6 billion in adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of more than $8.00 by FY30. The updated FY30 revenue target is approximately 45% higher than the $5.2 billion target presented at last year’s Capital Markets Day (November 2025). The increase reflects the expansion of Nextpower’s platform and growth opportunities across its existing markets.


Power collection and conversion and energy storage are each expected to become billion-dollar businesses by FY30. Revenue from new non-tracker product lines is expected to represent slightly more than half of the company’s total revenue in FY30, compared with approximately 32% in the company’s prior FY30 framework and 12% of FY26 revenue.


“Nextpower has evolved into an industrial power technology company,” said Dan Shugar, CEO and founder of Nextpower. “Our leadership in trackers remains the foundation of the business. Greater attachment of power conversion, energy storage and eBOS is expected to drive accelerated growth, with software and services supporting offerings across the portfolio. Together, these capabilities help customers generate, store, and control power, extending the value we deliver over time.”


"The platform combines strong cash generation with disciplined investment,” said Chuck Boynton, CFO of Nextpower. “A capital-efficient model and strong cash conversion support investment in the next phase of growth. As those investments scale, they are expected to drive revenue growth and margin expansion while supporting attractive through-cycle margins.”


At Capital Markets Day, Nextpower also presented updates on its power generation and energy storage businesses, technology roadmaps, operations and execution, and long-term financial framework. The company also discussed plans to ramp U.S. inverter manufacturing capacity to 10 gigawatts by calendar year-end 2027 with shipments under a 1.1-gigawatt framework agreement expected to begin from its U.S. facility in summer 2027.


The presentation and webcast replay are available on Nextpower’s Investor Relations[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nextpower.com&esheet=54642492&newsitemid=20261117426961&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=1&md5=f618db99e57a1d86491b8ac314891568) .

**About Nextpower**


Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT) innovates and delivers integrated technology solutions for modern energy infrastructure. Its solar and energy storage platforms help customers design, build, and operate utility-scale power plants and other critical power infrastructure with faster project delivery, improved system performance, greater reliability, and long-term operational value. Building on more than a decade of energy technology leadership, Nextpower partners with customers worldwide to accelerate the deployment of reliable firm power needed for a rapidly electrifying world.
